zoeyDesign.existing.records.include.draw: 现有资料基础：图纸与 Permit 文件类型、任务及等待记录、检查日期 / 结果 / 整改人 / 备注。三种聚合工作界面是本次设计提案；没有新增政府审批状态、预计许可时长或图纸版本审批。申请回执不等于核发 Permit；Final 仍以最近一次 Final 检查及节点确认规则为准。

Existing records include drawings, Permit file types, tasks, waiting notes, and inspection dates, results, correction assignees, and notes. These three workspaces are design proposals; they add no government approval states, Permit estimates, or drawing-version reviews. An application receipt is not an issued Permit. Final still follows the latest Final Inspection and milestone confirmation rules.
